query:
SELECT l.version
                      FROM kb_migration_ledger l
                     WHERE l.state = 'pending'
                       AND NOT EXISTS (
                           SELECT 1
                             FROM kb_migration_ledger t
                            WHERE t.version = l.version
                              AND t.state IN ('success', 'failed', 'cancelled')
                              AND t.id > l.id
                       )
                     ORDER BY l.version
                     LIMIT 1
